text: I'm so sorry to be messaging this late, I know you must be really busy and it's probably nothing. My daughter Amara is 4 and she's had a temperature since yesterday. Honestly she's been okay with it, between her doses of Calpol and ibuprofen she's playing with her dolls, drinking her juice, chatting away like normal. But tonight when I was putting her to bed something looked off. She's got dark skin so it's hard to tell on her face, so I checked the palms of her hands and the inside of her bottom lip like my mum always told me to, and they looked really pale, almost greyish, not the pink they usually are. Her mouth inside looked kind of washed out too. I compared with my own hands and it's definitely different. I don't know if I'm just being paranoid because it's dark and I'm tired, and I really don't want to waste anyone's time, but I thought I'd better ask. Sorry again.
